messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: HOW drawing  relative bias
parts: how can the relative bias be calculated in relation to the sample size

Relative bias is not a property of sample size, only the population parameter and average estimate (for a given sample size, estimator, etc.).  Your graph already seems to display how it varies across sample sizes.
